versions.content: Name Mirror_ConfigType Kind Structure Implementation specific. Type  Elements Comment  Description This is the base type for the configuration of the Bus Mirroring module. A pointer to an instance of this structure will be used in the initialization of the Bus Mirroring module. The content of this structure is defined in chapter 10 Configuration specification. Available via Mirror.h
